annotations.title: Is this becoming material to companies?

description: Use when the user asks whether a risk, technology or theme is spreading through public companies, or whether companies now treat it as material. Returns, year by year, the share of U.S. 10-K filers that mention the phrase, from SEC EDGAR full-text search, with a denominator control ("competition") and a null control ("shrinkflation") that must read 0. Every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. Calling this tool returns a quote, not the result: what the run measures, its price and a payment_url. The run happens only when you POST to payment_url, and a run that fails its controls refuses there with nothing charged. Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. For named companies rather than all filers, use run_disclosure_check; for filings, rules and spending together, use run_triangulation. A real sample of this run, free: https://cultmath.com/agent/samples/filing-trend.json

end.description: Last year, not in the future. Default: this year. At most 10 years per run.

phrase.description: The phrase to count, without quote marks, e.g. "tariff" or "GLP-1".

start.description: First year (2001 onward). Default: four years ago.
